answer: Each agent identity must lock a bond of 30 credits or present a hardware credential signed once per device with a registered cipher. An attacker minting N fakes locks 30N credits and forfeits 70 percent of each bond across a 9-epoch challenge window. Copying identities gains nothing because every fake adds 30 credits of marginal cost, shares the slashed penalty, and independent jurors can forge a challenge against any sonnet-like burst of registrations.
